Please take a moment
Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers must follow pet check-in rules before departure to keep animals safe and boarding smooth.

Carry approved documents, secure carriers, and leash pets at all handoffs. The passenger coordinator will review steps with travelers, and the ground team will move carriers carefully between services. <<FACT F021>> Keep pets calm and close, and report any stress, illness, or escape risk at once.

For Merrowgate, use the pet lounge and relief area exactly as directed. <<FACT F005>> <<FACT F017>> Follow staff instructions, since unsafe handling can delay travel and place animals at risk.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways for guidance before boarding.
